own_solution.law: Physical pendulum, small amplitude: T = 2 pi sqrt((L^2/12 + d^2)/(g d))

notes: Verified R answers: q=18 cm (d=0.12 m) -> 2 pi sqrt(0.1344/1.176) = 2.12410 s; q=20.5 cm (d=0.095 m) -> 2 pi sqrt(0.129025/0.931) = 2.33906 s (my pass-1 2.33907 was a last-digit rounding slip; a more careful evaluation gives 2.339063); q=22 cm (d=0.08 m) -> 2 pi sqrt(0.1264/0.784) = 2.52287 s. All shifted pivots stay on the rod with d > 0. Mass cancellation correct. Minimal pairs T1443/T1D34 (second rod vs rod) and TFD4F/TFE49 (earlier experiment vs before swinging) share 20.5 cm and differ only in attachment; TA36F/T2919 share 1.1 kg (T2919 adds 'steel strip', harmless); TF2C6 and T7714 are declared numeral-free twins. The 'distance at the outset' clause reconciles the pre-swing pivot move with the stated 0.3 m.
